Description: Display count of new or additional maintenance for the specified period
Expression:
COUNT(from a in db->Equipment_calc where 
AND(
    EQUALS(a->PMPlans_calc->PMType_calc->Frequency_calc, $PlannedPeriod_calc), 
    NOT(EQUALS(a->MaintenanceExecution_calc->SortOrder_calc , ADDYEARS($PlannedPeriod_calc->WorkStartDate_calc, ($Year_calc->Year - 2024))))
    ) select a->id)
Name: Additional PM by period
